summary: Temporary drone restricted area around RAF Lakenheath, Suffolk, 5 nautical miles radius, surface to 1,200 feet above sea level.
text:
RESTRICTED AREA (TEMPORARY) INSTALLED FOR UAS ONLY (RAF
LAKENHEATH, SUFFOLK) WI 5NM RADIUS OF PSN 522433.85N 0003339.64E.
PILOTS ARE FORBIDDEN TO FLY UAS WITHIN THE DESIGNATED AREA WO THE
PERMISSION OF EMERGENCY CONTROLLING AUTHORITY: RAF LAKENHEATH ATC
UNIT CTC TEL 01638-543610 OR EMAIL USAFE-UK.A3(AT)US.AF.MIL.
RESTRICTION OF FLYING REGULATIONS MADE UNDER ARTICLE 239 OF AIR
NAV ORDER 2016. AR-2026-10692/04.
